lead: `nvs-cli`'s `sd_notify_messages_are_ready_…_then_stopping` can fail with foreign `READY=1`/`STOPPING=1` lines ahead of its own
body: , then pass alone and on the next full run. `Notify::install` writes a process-global `OnceLock`, so this case's recorder also collects what a served life running beside it in the same binary reports. Re-run `python tools/verify.py` before reading it as yours; fixing it means scoping that global, not editing the case.
